title: Enterprise Connectivity: monthly amendment ceiling
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following monthly amendment ceiling for each named contract tier. Maximum accepted capacity amendments per holding in a UTC calendar month; integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | monthly amendment ceiling | 12 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | monthly amendment ceiling | 12 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | monthly amendment ceiling | 12 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | monthly amendment ceiling | 12 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | monthly amendment ceiling | 12 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | monthly amendment ceiling | 12 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the monthly amendment ceiling is 12.
